text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grand year-end stage, the Arima Kinen. 
Kitasan Black crossed the finish line in 
first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What decided victory in the end was the 
sheer volume of cheers backing her. 
Kitasan Black had finally made her dream 
of bringing smiles to everyone come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond made an everlasting promise 
with Kitasan Black to keep running 
together well into the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the "Festival Leader," Kitasan 
Black was met with earth-shattering 
cheers. Standing at the center with a 
beaming smile, she became everyone's 
beloved Uma Musume.
